result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found 2 minor layout issues related to text and card truncation.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge, with its name and image truncated abruptly rather than showing a smooth partial-card peek.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items have consistent padding and a clear partial-visibility affordance so the truncated card reads as scrollable content.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only the top portion of the item.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.
